topic: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid

claims.claim: The Great Pyramid of Giza was completed around 2560 BC (estimates c. 2580-2510 BC).
Cleopatra VII died in 30 BC (12 August), about 2,500 years after the pyramid was finished.
claims.note: 2560 BC -> 30 BC = 2,530 years; with the latest pyramid estimate (2510 BC) still 2,480. Script says 'about 2,500'.

claims.claim: The Apollo 11 Moon landing was on 20 July 1969, about 2,000 years after Cleopatra's death.
So she lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the Great Pyramid's construction (margin ~500 years, larger than the dating uncertainty).

rejected.claim: Cleopatra lived closer to Pizza Hut / the iPhone.
rejected.reason: True-ish but off-brand and sources are sloppy.
